title: The French test / too & enough
subtitle: 法语考试 / 太……与足够……

lead.question: 考试出了考场，你问同学「考得怎样」——怎么问？怎么答「不太坏/恐怕不及格」？「题目太难了」用 too 还是 too much？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。考试后最常聊的就是难不难：Not too bad.（不算太坏）/ I hope I haven't failed.（希望别不及格）。表达「太难」「不够容易」要用固定搭配：形容词 + enough（easy enough 够容易），too + 形容词（too difficult 太难），后面还可以接 for sb（对某人来说）甚至 to do sth（以至于不能……）。先试着把「这题对我来说太难了」「这题够简单」说出来，再听 Harry 和 Dick 对答案。
goals: 能围绕考试展开问答：How was the examination? / Not too bad. / pass / fail
掌握 enough 的位置：形容词之后、名词之前（easy enough / enough money）
掌握 too + 形容词（+ for sb）(+ to do sth) 表示「太……以至于不能……」
会读会写 I.Q./Intelligence Test 等话题词汇，理解 cheer up 等口语
lead.summary: 第 103 课 Harry 问 Dick 考得怎样。Dick 觉得英语和数学不难、应该及格了；Harry 却嫌试卷不够容易，生怕不及格。Dick 说自己法语考砸了——16 道题都会，其余太难；Harry 安慰他：坐他旁边的那人三个小时只写了个名字、一个字都没写！第 104 课集中操练 too ... to 与 (not) ... enough (for sb) to do。
lead.tips: ① enough 修饰形容词时放后面（easy enough），修饰名词时放前面（enough money）；② too + adj. + for sb (+ to do) 表示「对某人来说太……（而不能……）」，too 后不接 that 从句；③ pass in + 科目「（某科）及格」，fail (the paper)「不及格」；④ the rest「其余的」要带定冠词；⑤ at the top of「在……顶端」，反义 at the bottom of；⑥ cheer up「振作点、别灰心」。

questions.q: How long did the exam last?
questions.hint: 听 ...he sat there and looked at it for three hours!

questions.q: What does Dick think about his English and Maths papers?
questions.zh: 迪克觉得自己的英语和数学考得怎么样？
questions.a: Not too bad — he thinks he passed in English and Mathematics because the questions were very easy.
questions.aZh: 不算太坏——他觉得自己英语和数学及格了，因为题目很容易。
questions.hint: 听 Dick 的第一句长回答。

questions.q: How many questions could Dick answer? What about the rest?
questions.zh: 迪克能答出多少道题？其余的呢？
questions.a: He could answer sixteen of the questions. He couldn't answer the rest — they were too difficult for him.
questions.aZh: 他能答出十六道题。其余的答不出来——那些题对他来说太难了。
questions.hint: sixteen ... But I couldn't answer the rest.

questions.q: What did the guy next to Harry do during the exam?
questions.zh: 坐在哈里旁边的那个人考试时做了什么？
questions.a: He wrote his name at the top of the paper, then sat there and looked at it for three hours. He didn't write a word!
questions.aZh: 他只在试卷顶端写了自己的名字，然后就坐在那儿对着考卷看了三个小时，一个字也没写！
questions.hint: Harry 讲的笑话：The guy next to me ...

questions.q: Why do we say 'weren't easy enough' but 'too difficult' — why not 'enough easy' or 'too much difficult'?
questions.zh: 为什么说 weren't easy enough、too difficult，而不能说 enough easy 或 too much difficult？
questions.a: enough as an adverb always follows the adjective (easy enough); when it modifies a noun it goes before the noun (enough money). too goes directly before an adjective (too difficult); too much is used with uncountable nouns, not with adjectives.
questions.aZh: enough 修饰形容词时必须后置（easy enough），修饰名词时前置（enough money）；too 直接放在形容词前（too difficult），too much 只能修饰不可数名词，不能修饰形容词。
questions.hint: 记位置：enough 形后名前，too 形前。

questions.q: It was too expensive for him to buy. / It was cheap enough for him to buy.
questions.zh: 第 104 课操练：用 too ... (for sb) to do 与 (not) ... enough (for sb) to do 描述「能不能做到」。
questions.a: The suitcase was too heavy for me to carry. / It was light enough for me to carry.
questions.aZh: 这箱子太沉了，我扛不动。/ 它很轻，我扛得动。
questions.hint: too 表否定结果（不能），enough 表肯定结果（能）。

lines.speaker: DICK
lines.en: Not too bad. I think I passed in English and Mathematics. The questions were very easy. How about you, Harry?
lines.zh: 不算太坏，我想我的英语和数学及格了。题目很容易。加里，你怎么样？

lines.speaker: HARRY
lines.en: The English and Maths papers weren't easy enough for me. I hope I haven't failed.
lines.zh: 英语和数学试题对我来说不很容易。我希望别不及格。

lines.speaker: DICK
lines.en: I think I failed the French paper. I could answer sixteen of the questions. They were very easy. But I couldn't answer the rest. They were too difficult for me.
lines.zh: 我想我的法语没及格。我能回答其中的16道题，这些题很容易。但我回答不出其余的题，那些题对我来说太难了。

lines.speaker: HARRY
lines.en: French tests are awful, aren't they?
lines.zh: 法语考试太可怕了，你说呢？

lines.speaker: DICK
lines.en: I hate them. I'm sure I've got a low mark.
lines.zh: 我讨厌法语考试。我的分数肯定很低。

lines.speaker: HARRY
lines.en: Oh, cheer up! Perhaps we didn't do too badly. The guy next to me wrote his name at the top of the paper.
lines.zh: 啊，别灰心！或许我们考得还不太糟。坐在我旁边的那个人只在试卷顶端写了自己的名字。

lines.speaker: HARRY
lines.en: Then he sat there and looked at it for three hours! He didn't write a word!
lines.zh: 然后他就坐在那里，对着考卷看了3个小时，一个字也没写！

drill.q: It/They was (were) too ___ for him/her/them to ___ . / It/They was (were) ___ enough for him/her/them to ___ .
drill.zh: 太……（以至于不能做）/ 足够……（能够做）——用 too 与 enough 操练 possible/impossible。
answers: Yes, he could. It was cheap enough for him to buy.
No, he couldn't. It was too expensive for him to buy.

quiz.note: are 问 are 答；they 指复数的 tests。

grammar.title: enough 的用法
grammar.structure: 形容词 + enough / enough + 名词（+ for sb / to do sth）
grammar.definition: enough 作副词修饰形容词或副词时必须后置（easy enough）；作形容词修饰名词时前置（enough money）。常接 enough ... for sb/sth 或 enough ... to do sth。
grammar.usage: He failed the exam because it wasn't easy enough. / She's not old enough to live alone.

examples.en: This dress isn't big enough for her.
examples.zh: 这件衣服对她来说不够大。

examples.en: He didn't buy the car because he didn't have enough money.
examples.zh: 他没买那部车，因为他没有足够的钱。

grammar.title: too ... (for sb) (to do sth)
grammar.structure: too + 形容词/副词 (+ for sb/sth) (+ to do sth)
grammar.definition: too 表示「过于」，常构成 too ... for sb「对某人来说太……」和 too ... to do sth「太……以至于不能做某事」（含否定结果）。
grammar.usage: It's too hot. / She couldn't answer the questions because they were too difficult for her.

examples.en: The box is too heavy for you to carry.
examples.zh: 这个盒子太沉了，你没法扛起。

examples.en: The wall is too high for them to climb over.
examples.zh: 这堵墙太高了，他们无法攀越过去。

grammar.title: too 与 enough 对比
grammar.structure: too + adj. + to do（不能……）↔ adj. + enough + to do（能够……）
grammar.definition: too 后接不定式表示否定结果（做不到）；enough 后接不定式表示肯定结果（做得到）。
grammar.usage: 比较：The wall is too high for them to climb over. / The wall is low enough for them to climb over.

examples.en: It was too expensive for him to buy.
examples.zh: 它太贵了，他买不起。

examples.en: It was cheap enough for him to buy.
examples.zh: 它够便宜，他买得起。

phrases.usage: 不算太坏（回答 How was ...?）

examples.en: How was the examination, Dick? — Not too bad.
examples.zh: 考试考得怎样，理查德？——不算太坏。

examples.en: I think I passed in English and Mathematics.
examples.zh: 我想我的英语和数学及格了。

phrases.usage: 其余的（部分），与定冠词连用

examples.en: But I couldn't answer the rest.
examples.zh: 但我回答不出其余的题。

examples.en: Oh, cheer up! Perhaps we didn't do too badly.
examples.zh: 啊，别灰心！或许我们考得还不太糟。

examples.en: The guy next to me wrote his name at the top of the paper.
examples.zh: 坐在我旁边的那个人在试卷顶端写了自己的名字。

phrases.usage: 在……顶端（反义：at the bottom of）

examples.en: He wrote his name at the top of the paper.
examples.zh: 他在试卷顶端写了自己的名字。
